dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "As long as we stay on this course, following the waves... We just need one good strong gust of wind."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Well, as it happens, the wind direction changes in quite a unique way when the moon rises at this time of the year."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Yep, I know the winds in these seas like the back of my hand!"
